printable.text: Along the way, he changed number cards, mixed food labels, swapped costume parts, copied false repair reports, hid a metal weight inside a game, turned parts of the Grand Pavilion and sent power to the sealed launcher on the Moon Deck.

printable.text: The volunteers now have two jobs, and the jobs cannot be separated. A repaired fair cannot leave without the Bell. The Bell cannot safely carry a damaged fair onto the Moon Path. They must repair ChandRush and recover the Bell before moonset.
